recommendedTargetPolicy.plainLanguageQuestion: Should /tournaments/:tournamentId/* Engine routes require authentication and tournament permissions at least as strong as legacy /tournament/* before Preview flag ON?
recommendedTargetPolicy.recommendedLabel: Remove plural routes from public-auth prefix descendants; require auth; route-level permission tournament.update (matching page gate) or documented split; add tenant/club ownership check before engine load

rejectedOptions.label: Keep /tournaments/* public-auth
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than legacy; exposes engine deep links when auth production enabled

rejectedOptions.label: Only require tournament.view
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than current page PermissionGate tournament.update for mutating tabs

recommendedTargetPolicy.consequence: Closes Preview blocker BLK-PLURAL-AUTHZ. Public catalog /tournaments (list) remains public; parameterized Engine family becomes protected.
recommendedTargetPolicy.risk: Deep links that previously worked anonymously will require login — intentional hardening.
recommendedTargetPolicy.implementationImpact: authGuard.js PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES refinement; menuAccess.js plural matcher; optional ownership assert in useTournamentEngine/RouteAccessGate; tests in phase4-tournament-authz.

missingTestsAggregate: Engine missing-ID/breadcrumb no longer depends on unprotected public plural access
